findings.evidence: `Basic.lean:440-446` defines the weaker predicate as exactly closed-half-line continuity plus open-half-line complete monotonicity, which are the only outer-function properties used at lines 215, 218, and 221; the representation theorem at line 264 also consumes this weaker predicate.
findings.fix: Move both theorems to `IsContinuousCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` and replace uses of `hg.contDiffOn.continuousOn`/`hg.isCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` with `hg.continuousOn`/`hg.isCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi`.
findings.issue: `comp_isBernsteinFunction` requires `IsCompletelyMonotone g`, although its conclusion and proof need only `IsContinuousCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi g`; the same over-strong assumption recurs in `exists_representsLaplace_comp_isBernsteinFunction` at line 261.

summary: The principal composition and subordination APIs impose unnecessarily strong endpoint smoothness on the outer function.
